spanish: Balanzas de justicia, piedras de justicia, efá de justicia e hin de justicia serán a ustedes; yo Jehová su Dios, que saqué a ustedes desde tierra de Egipto.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is plural serán so the coordinated list can be the Spanish subject; the predication to the addressees is unchanged.

notes: צדק is repeated, 2mp is ustedes, and Jehová, Dios, and Egipto stay within the tokens.
